# assertion polarity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assertionPolarity`](gmeow-assertionPolarity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assertionPolarity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accessibility`](../../slices/accessibility.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Whether the assertion is a positive feature, a negative barrier, or a limited/partial status. Functional per relator: one polarity per [`AccessibilityAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-AccessibilityAssertion.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:AccessibilityAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-AccessibilityAssertion.md) -> [`gmeow:AccessibilityPolarity`](../classes/gmeow-AccessibilityPolarity.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:assertionPolarity`](gmeow-assertionPolarity.md) from [`gmeow:AccessibilityAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-AccessibilityAssertion.md) to [`gmeow:AccessibilityPolarity`](../classes/gmeow-AccessibilityPolarity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Location Access

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/accessibility/examples/location-access.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/accessibility/examples/location-access.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-accessibility-examples-location-access)#example-slices-extensions-accessibility-examples-location-access

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: accessibility as MATCHABLE facets. One open vocabulary of
# gmeow:AccessibilityFacets (wheelchair, step-free, visual, auditory, cognitive …)
# is used across three relations: what a location HAS
# (gmeow:hasAccessibilityFeature), what it lacks as a gmeow:hasBarrier, and what an
# agent NEEDS (gmeow:hasAccessibilityNeed). Because need and feature draw on the
# same vocabulary, "Dana needs wheelchair access" and "the library has wheelchair
# access" MATCH directly. A reified gmeow:AccessibilityAssertion records who
# claims which facet, with a gmeow:assertionPolarity (feature / barrier / limited).
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/accessibility/> .

# --- A reified assertion: a surveyor claims the library is step-free (a feature).
ex:assertion a gmeow:AccessibilityAssertion ;
    gmeow:assertionSubject  ex:library ;
    gmeow:assertionFacet    gmeow:facetStepFree ;
    gmeow:assertionPolarity gmeow:polarityFeature .
```
